The two lives ran together for {identical_months} months, until month {fork_month}, when you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}.
The ghost's Safety ended {safety_gap}, and it could last longer with no pay.
The ghost's Freedom ended {freedom_gap}, and more of its pay was committed before each month began.
By month {end_month}, the ghost had {net_worth_gap}.
